da-non-sequitur.notes: The crux step — transient vanishing on Σ_0 — is asserted with a one-line topological hand-wave ('trivial topology ⇒ sections factor through level n'). This is the load-bearing inference for the whole lemma; 'all sections there factor through level n' is stated without a cited lemma or Lean witness. The nonabelian-Stokes second equality (yekutieli2015) is fine; the first equality (MI∫_Σ = MI∫_{Σ_0}) depends on this unproved vanishing. Major logical gap.
